title: Vegetarian Skillet Delight
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make skillet dish packed with smoky flavors and kissed with a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 pound, substitute with portobello mushrooms for vegetarian option

instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sauté the onions until they're translucent.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms (or chicken, if using) and cook until browned.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
